notice.N-DATA-FETCH.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, run the simulation again.
notice.N-EXPORT-FAIL.fix: Check the free disk space and export again.
notice.N-MISSING.fix: Enter a value in the Spec panel.
notice.N-OPEN-ENCODING.fix: Re-save it as UTF-8 in a text editor.
notice.N-OPEN-MULTI.fix: Choose the one spec JSON you want to open.
notice.N-OPEN-MULTI.what: {n} files were dropped. Only one can be opened at a time.
notice.N-OPEN-READ.fix: Check that the file hasn't been moved or deleted, then choose it again.
notice.N-OPEN-SCHEMA.fix: Fix the places listed below. Save a sample to see the format.
notice.N-OPEN-SCHEMA.what: {file} doesn't match the spec format ({n} place(s)).
notice.N-OPEN-SIZE.fix: Check that you chose a spec JSON.
notice.N-OPEN-SIZE.what: {file} is too large ({size}). A spec JSON can be up to 10 MB.
notice.N-OPEN-SYNTAX.fix: Check commas, quotes and brackets near that position.
notice.N-OPEN-TEMPLATE.what: This app has no template named "{template}".
notice.N-OPEN-TYPE.fix: This version opens spec JSON files only. Save a sample to see the format.
notice.N-OPEN-VERSION.fix: Update the app, or rewrite the spec in version {supported}.
notice.N-OPEN-VERSION.what: {file} uses spec version {found}. This app reads version {supported}.
notice.N-PLOTS-FULL.fix: Hide another signal to free a plot.
notice.N-PLOTS-FULL.what: There can be up to 4 plots. {signal} can't be shown.
notice.N-RUN-CIRCUIT.fix: Check the Spec panel for extremely large or small values.
notice.N-RUN-CIRCUIT.what: Run {n} failed: the circuit equations can't be solved with these values.
notice.N-RUN-DIVERGED.fix: Use a smaller time step and run again. For circuits with control, check the gains too.
notice.N-RUN-DIVERGED.what: Run {n} failed: {signal} stopped being finite at t = {t} (diverged).
notice.N-RUN-INTERNAL.fix: If it happens again with the same values, report it with the spec JSON and the details.
notice.N-RUN-INTERNAL.what: Run {n} failed: an unexpected error occurred.
notice.N-RUN-MEMORY.fix: Use an earlier stop time or a larger time step.
notice.N-RUN-MEMORY.what: Run {n} failed: the simulation is too large for the available memory ({steps} steps).
notice.N-RUN-NOTE-ROUND.fix: To avoid rounding, choose a time step that divides the step time evenly.
notice.N-RUN-NOTE-ROUND.what: The step time of {id}, {t}, was rounded to {t_grid} to fit the time step.
notice.N-RUN-NOTE-STEP.fix: Use a time step of {h_suggest} or less and run again. Leave it blank to go back to the automatic value.
notice.N-RUN-NOTE-STEP.what: In run {n}, the time step {h} was coarse for this circuit's fastest time constant ({tau}); the waveforms may be inaccurate.
notice.N-RUN-STEPS.fix: Use an earlier stop time or a larger time step. Keeping the time step, the stop time can be up to {t_max}; keeping the stop time, the time step must be at least {h_min}.
notice.N-RUN-STEPS.what: Run {n} didn't start: the step count is {steps}, over the limit of {limit} for one run.
notice.N-RUN-SWITCH.fix: Use a smaller time step and run again.
notice.N-RUN-SWITCH.what: Run {n} failed: the switch and diode states didn't settle at t = {t}.
notice.N-SAVE-INVALID.fix: Fix the input, then save again.
notice.N-SAVE-INVALID.what: Values with input errors ({list}) were saved with their last valid value.
notice.N-SIGNALS-FULL.what: Up to 8 signals can be shown at once.
notice.N-STALE.fix: Run again to see waveforms for the current values.
notice.N-STALE.what: The scope shows a result computed before you changed the spec (run {n}).
notice.N-STEP-COARSE.fix: Use a time step of {h_suggest} or less. Leave it blank to go back to the automatic value.
notice.N-STEP-COARSE.what: The time step {h} is coarse for this circuit's fastest time constant ({tau}); the waveforms may be inaccurate.
notice.N-STEPS-LIMIT.fix: Use an earlier stop time or a larger time step. Keeping the time step, the stop time can be up to {t_max}; keeping the stop time, the time step must be at least {h_min}.
notice.N-STEPS-LIMIT.what: The step count is {steps}, over the limit of {limit} for one run.
notice.N-UNIT-CONVERTED.fix: Check that the values in the Spec panel are what you intended. Saving writes them in base units.
notice.N-UNIT-CONVERTED.what: Values written with prefixed units were converted to base units: {list} (e.g. L: 47 uH → 4.7e-5 H)
notice.N-UNIT-WRONG.what: The spec JSON gives "{text}" for {symbol} ({name}). This item is in {unit}.
notice.N-UNUSED.fix: Remove them from the spec JSON if they aren't needed. Saving keeps them as they are.
notice.N-UNUSED.what: This template doesn't use these values: {list}. They are ignored in the simulation.
